title: Seller- or Builder-Funded Buydown Add-Back, Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit
content:
**Interest Rate Buydown add-back — Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit**

Concession money spent on a buydown does not pay closing costs. For a Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit measured against the latest Loan Estimate, the Interest Rate Buydown on the loan file is read as follows:

- where a temporary buydown on the file is funded or to be funded by the seller or builder, whatever its status, its subsidy amount is added back;
- where the file's buydown is instead a permanent buydown funded or to be funded by the seller or builder, its points cost is added back;
- any other buydown, or none, adds nothing back.

The add-back is added to the costs the Heroes credit can still pay, together with the other terms of those costs, before the floor at zero.

| Buydown on the file | Funded by | Added back |
|---|---|---|
| temporary | seller or builder (funded or to be funded, any status) | the subsidy amount |
| permanent | seller or builder (funded or to be funded) | the points cost |
| temporary or permanent | the borrower or Larkspur | nothing |
| none | — | nothing |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- A Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown with a subsidy amount of 6240.00, to be funded by the builder and still only elected: 6240.00 is added back.
- A Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown with a points cost of 7000.00, funded by the seller: 7000.00 is added back.
- A temporary buydown paid by Larkspur: nothing is added back.
